description: GNN + IMM tuned for a MANEUVERING underwater contact (sonar). Sonar gives range+bearing -> Cartesian, so the standard Cartesian filters apply (no special angle-only filter is needed the way IR requires one). The contact turns, so IMM (CV+CT) with adequate process noise is required - a plain CV or low-noise filter lags the turn and fragments (empirically 650 m vs 4.7 m). The only sonar-specific change from the aircraft default is init_speed 60 km/h (vs 900). Verified ~4.7 m posRMS, single clean track on SONAR_TEST.
